scope_decision: Suitable for explicitly simplified historical exterior envelope; not measured survey, current-condition model or exact restoration.
period: 1981 completion to before addition of central external stair in 1987
supported: Three above-ground storeys and L-shaped plan with chamfered re-entrant courtyard corner (fig3/4).
Two terminal stair zones in floor plans; do not substitute later central exterior stair.
Slender vertical exterior fins/window rhythm and strong horizontal storey bands in early photos.
Generally flat roof with raised local rectangular rooftop masses visible in fig5 left; detailed function/shape not fully established.
Ground storey has larger openings and piers in fig6 left; upper facade not identical to ground.
limitations: Plan image numeral resolution is inadequate for this reviewer to independently validate exact metre dimensions; proportional tracing and all heights/depths need estimation labels.
Outer drawing lines may represent projected eaves or slab boundaries rather than ground wall: do not confuse them with occupied ground-storey envelope.
Early photographs are foliage-obstructed and do not constitute complete four-elevation survey. Unseen rear apertures should remain simplified/unclaimed.
Window/fins exact counts, colours, structural sizes and roof equipment are not fully verifiable from these images.
Basement is mentioned in official history but underground volume/interior is not exterior evidence and may be omitted explicitly.
anachronism_guards: fig5 right is approximately 1989, therefore not a primary pre-1987 detail authority.
fig6 left is before steel stair; fig6 right is after steel stair and must not control pre-1987 central stair geometry.
fig10 left is 2011 and right 2025; omit their steel/RC central stair, glass entrance canopy, later shop signs and vegetation from historical reconstruction.
The dark pitched tiled roof in front/right of fig5 left belongs to neighbouring building, not Xiaofu; do not attach it to the target.
publication_notes: Public package should include authored geometry, references/links and evidence notes but not bundled copyrighted reference images.
Must label estimated dimensions, unknown details, historical scope and no trial print.
